findings.defect: actual_stub changes mirror basename to owned-leaf but leaves template runId unchanged. Actual recorder.lane requires mirrorPath.name == runId. Nominal test07 therefore necessarily returns STOP and cannot satisfy its positive assertion.
findings.minimalRepair: Set owned stub runId to the owned mirror leaf basename before serializing binding and starting the stub; retain every existing source/receipt/exit/cleanup/cap assertion.

findings.defect: prepare independently hashes the supplied source manifest/files and supplied accepted review but never requires review.sourcePinsSha256 == --source-pins-sha. Matching recorder/supervisor hashes alone does not establish that the accepted review covers the supplied complete package/template. Manifest/template productionHead consistency is likewise not asserted before imports/output creation.
findings.minimalRepair: Before output-root creation/imports, require the exact accepted review sourcePinsSha256 to equal the authenticated supplied manifest SHA, and require authenticated manifest productionHead/productionSourceTree to match the authenticated binding template. Preserve the parameterized future exact review and avoid assuming the pending checkpoint HEAD.
